verdict.rationale: Galileo documents an official MCP server with its own setup page. It connects AI-powered IDEs and agents such as Cursor and VS Code with GitHub Copilot to the platform, and exposes capabilities like creating datasets, running experiments, and setting up prompt templates. A probe confirmed the setup page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the server works as described, and evidence of authentication/configuration details and the full tool list.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The Galileo Model Context Protocol (MCP) server enables seamless integration between AI-powered IDEs, such as Cursor, or VS Code with GitHub Copilot, and Galileo's evaluation and observability platform.
With MCP, you can access Galileo's capabilities directly from your development environment, including: Creating and managing datasets, Running experiments, Setting up prompt templates
